headline: AN ACT TO AMEND DELAWARE CODE, TITLE 14 BY PROVIDING FOR A DELAWARE PUBLIC SCHOOL ENROLLEES' IMMUNIZATION PROGRAM AND EXEMPTIONS.
source: Delaware General Assembly, Laws of Delaware
blurb: This Delaware law told the State Board of Education to set up an immunization program for public school students, with exemptions for medical reasons and for religious beliefs.

headline: Pertussis Outbreak in an Amish Community --- Kent County, Delaware, September 2004--February 2005
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A whooping cough outbreak in an Amish community in Kent County from September 2004 to February 2005 resulted in 345 cases, mostly in preschool-aged children.

headline: DPH Investigating Mumps Outbreak After February Baile Mejicano Dance at Chase Center on the Riverfront
blurb: Delaware health officials confirmed three mumps cases among people who went to a dance at the Chase Center on the Riverfront in Wilmington on February 10, 2018.

headline: DPH Investigating Outbreak of Whooping Cough in Kent County; Urging Residents to Get Vaccinated
blurb: Delaware health officials said they had found 97 whooping cough cases among Amish residents of Kent County as of August 18, 2018, in an investigation that began in June.

headline: The Delaware Division of Public Health Issues Notification About Potential Measles Exposure
blurb: Delaware health officials reported that an unvaccinated person with a measles case confirmed in Philadelphia had sought care at a Delaware health care facility on December 29, 2023, while infectious.
